sentenceSets.sentence: The wily negotiator had placed each concession where it would produce maximum goodwill while actually costing the minimum.

answerChoices.reasoning: Shrewd means keen in judgment and clever in business, but wily adds the element of cunning trickery—not just astute judgment but strategic deception.
Crafty means skillful in deception, but wily emphasizes the cunning strategy of appearing generous while minimizing actual cost.
Clever means mentally sharp, but wily specifically emphasizes cunning and strategic deception, not just intellectual sharpness.
Calculating means carefully planning for advantage, but wily adds the element of cunning trickery and strategic deception.
Strategic means planned to achieve long-term goals, but wily emphasizes cunning and trickery, not just strategy.
Tactful means showing skill in dealing with others, but wily emphasizes cunning deception, not diplomatic tact.
Diplomatic means using tact and skill in relations, but wily emphasizes cunning strategy, not diplomatic smoothness.
Astute means having keen judgment, but wily emphasizes cunning trickery more than shrewd analysis.
Naive means lacking experience or shrewdness, opposite to wily which shows cunning strategic deception.
Gullible means easily deceived, opposite to wily which characterizes someone who deceives through cunning.
Honest means sincere and truthful, opposite to wily which emphasizes cunning deception and trickery.
